description.en: The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstanceInfo](~~140857~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstanceInfo](~~140857~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh:
手动Bypass开启状态，取值：

- **on**：开启。

- **off（默认）**：关闭。
description.en:
The status of the manual bypass. Valid values:

- **on**: The manual bypass is enabled.

- **off** (default): The manual bypass is disabled.

title.zh: 修改混合云SDK集成集群手动Bypass开关

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi modify-hybrid-cloud-cluster-bypass-status --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --cluster-resource-id hdbc_cluster_0000 --rule-status on --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi ModifyHybridCloudClusterBypassStatus --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --ClusterResourceId hdbc_cluster_0000 --InstanceId 'waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000' --RuleStatus on --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
